title: Dog Night, 2007 · before
logline: The night before eight years: the alley's bulb out over the dumpster, and Wood with a new bulb in his coat pocket he doesn't put in. He wants to draw it by the neon tomorrow. The dog doesn't care what it's drawn by.

panels.composition: The alley at night, the bulb over the dumpster dark, the neon from the sign reaching in. WOOD and BARNABY.
